title: REPRODUCTION IN DOMESTIC ANIMALS LABORATORY
description: Gross and microscopic anatomy of the reproductive tract; semen collection, evaluation and extension; evaluation of fertilization, embryo and fetal development and placentation.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisite: ANS 316*.
* May be taken concurrently.
A minimum grade of D- is required in ANS 316.
books_html: No-cost: Course utilizes open educational resources, materials available through the library, or does not require any purchased materials.
meeting_html: T 2pm-3:50pm in OATF 109 - Oldfield Animal Teach Facility 109 (9/23 to 12/4)
